_comment: Copy to apps/api/config.json (gitignored) and fill in your values: cp config.example.json config.json. Field tables and precedence (env > file > built-in defaults) are in the README, section 'Service configuration files'. PORT is managed by scripts/dev.sh and is not a config-file field. workerToken must match the worker's token. Relative data paths resolve against the directory the API process starts in (scripts/dev.sh starts it in apps/api). Unknown keys like this one are ignored.
